title_en: Three years we were in love

audio.who: Влатко Миладиноски, Елена Ристеска, Зоран Џорлев

lines.en: Three years we were in love,
not a bad word was spoken (between us).

lines.cyr: Зар не ти е жал бре либе, аман ли за мене,
lines.lat: Zar ne ti e žal bre libe, aman li za mene,
lines.en: Have you no pity for me, love,

lines.cyr: јас да умрам сè заради тебе?
lines.lat: jas da umram sè zaradi tebe?
lines.en: for me to die because of you?
Your mother is singing songs (for you),
mine is laying tears for me.

they are bringing me to a hanging.
